name: Turncoat Officer
summary: A traitor in a stolen uniform who knows how the enemy fights and sells that knowledge.
description: The turncoat took coin, a grudge, or a better offer, and now leads bandits with all the drill their old commanders taught. Their former comrades remember the face, and some of them will not wait for the trial.

traits.name: Know the Plan
traits.text: The officer has {ref:glossary/advantage} on attack rolls against a creature that has already attacked one of the officer's allies since the end of the officer's last turn.

actions.name: Multiattack
actions.text: The officer makes three Rapier attacks.

actions.name: Sow Doubt

save.targets: each creature of the officer's choice within 30 feet that can hear it

actions.onFailure: The target also has {ref:glossary/disadvantage} on the next attack roll it makes before the end of its next turn.

reactions.name: Parry
reactions.text: *Trigger:* The officer is hit by a melee attack roll while holding a weapon. *Response:* The officer adds 3 to its AC against that attack, possibly causing it to miss.
